## Task-specific thinking overrides

Each existing LLM task has its own optional override. Use `true`, `false`, `1`, or `0`; leave it unset to preserve provider defaults and existing route behavior. A set override takes precedence over `AGENTMEMORY_AUX_LLM_NOTHINK` for its task. There is no global task-thinking variable.

- `AGENTMEMORY_GRAPH_LLM_THINKING`
- `AGENTMEMORY_TEMPORAL_GRAPH_LLM_THINKING`
- `AGENTMEMORY_CONSOLIDATION_LLM_THINKING`
- `AGENTMEMORY_COMPRESSION_LLM_THINKING`
- `AGENTMEMORY_SUMMARY_LLM_THINKING`
- `AGENTMEMORY_ENTITY_EXTRACTION_LLM_THINKING`
